## Safety classification

- [ ] No broker credentials, account records, positions, orders, individual fills, private evidence, or protected strategy thresholds are included.
- [ ] This does not enable trading, change owner/member authority, promote a strategy, or authorize a deployment.
- [ ] Any impact on order flow, risk policy, member isolation, archival evidence or infrastructure is explicitly described.
- [ ] I distinguish simulation, development, paper, and live evidence accurately.
- [ ] Any security-sensitive discovery is reported privately under [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
